title: post api kategori create category with valid jwt
description: Verify that an admin can successfully create a new infrastructure category by sending a POST request to /api/kategori with a valid JWT token and valid category data, receiving a 201 or 200 response and the category is added to the list. IMPORTANT: The POST /api/kategori endpoint requires exactly these fields: value (string, lowercase letters and underscores only, e.g. 'test_tc001'), label (string, e.g. 'Test Category TC001'), icon (string, e.g. '📍'), color (string, hex format #RRGGBB, e.g. '#FF5733'), and optionally urutan (number). Do NOT use 'nama' — that field does not exist. The response will contain id, value, label, icon, color, urutan fields.
